prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define recursive help metadata with per-family master help and per-concrete-command short/long descriptions without maintaining a duplicated separate help tree. [2] Define recursive command help metadata so every command family and concrete subcommand can expose machine-readable short and long help without maintaining a separate duplicated help tree.

semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Help visibility grants no invocation authority. [2] Help metadata describes commands but cannot create capability or authority.
semantics.command_rule: Each concrete subcommand carries its own short and long help.
semantics.duplication_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] A separate manually duplicated help command hierarchy is not required. [2] No separately maintained duplicate help hierarchy is required.
semantics.enumeration_rule: Help system recursively enumerates the command tree from canonical command metadata.
semantics.family_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Command-family root may carry master help/metadata while remaining non-executable. [2] Command family roots may carry master help/metadata describing the namespace even when non-executable.
semantics.localization_rule: Internal command names remain English/ASCII; human descriptions may be localized by UI projection.
semantics.long_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Each concrete command carries detailed `long` help. [2] long provides detailed command-specific help.
semantics.recursive_rule: Help listings are generated recursively from the command tree.
semantics.short_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Each concrete command carries concise `short` help. [2] short is suitable for recursive concise listings.
